prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Monochrome Signal: page #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #494949, secondary surface #E8E8E8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Roboto; geometric heading with functional sans text. Composition: Persistent navigation, dense results table, selected-item inspector, restrained headings. Use body 16px, heading 28px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
